title: Medicinal Mushrooms
mechanism_of_action: Polysaccharides, beta-glucans, and species-specific compounds are studied for immunomodulatory, neurotrophic, and adaptogenic effects.
contraindications: Use caution with anticoagulants, immunosuppressants, or allergy history involving fungi.
Extraction methods and concentrated powders may not be appropriate during pregnancy or before surgery without medical guidance.
summary: Entry shell for Turkey Tail/PSK, Lion's Mane, Reishi, and extraction protocol comparisons.
body:
## Research shell
Medicinal mushroom discussion often separates culinary use from concentrated extracts and standardization questions.

## Priority species
- Turkey Tail / PSK and PSP literature mapping.
- Lion's Mane questions around hericenones, erinacines, and substrate quality.
- Reishi comparisons between fruiting body, spore, and dual extract products.

## Extraction protocol notes
- Document water, alcohol, and dual-extraction tradeoffs.
- Compare low-tech kitchen methods with community-lab standardization goals.
- Record beta-glucan labeling clarity and contaminants screening questions.
